sn22.126:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā || pa || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn22.126:2.1: Idha bhikkhu assutavā puthujjano samudayadhammaṃ rūpaṃ Samudayadhammaṃ rūpanti yathādhammaṃ na pajānāti ||
sn22.126:2.2: vayadhammaṃ rūpaṃ Vayadhammam rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti ||
sn22.126:2.3: samudayavayadhammaṃ rupaṃ Samudayavayadhammaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || 5
sn22.126:2.4: Samudayadhammaṃ vedanaṃ Samudayadhammā vedanāti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti ||
sn22.126:2.5: vayadhammaṃ vedanaṃ Vayadhammā vedanā ti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānati ||
sn22.126:2.6: samudayavayadhammaṃ vedanaṃ Samudayavayadhammā vedanāti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || 6
sn22.126:2.8: Samudayadhamme saṅkhāre Samudayadhammā saṅkhārāti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti ||
sn22.126:2.9: vayadhamme saṅkhāre Vayadhammā saṅkhārāti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti ||
sn22.126:2.10: samudayavayadhamme saṅkhāre Samudayavayadhammā saṅkhārāti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || || 8
sn22.126:2.11: Samudayadhammaṃ viññāṇam Samudayadhammaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti ||
sn22.126:2.12: vayadhammaṃ viññāṇaṃ Vayadhammaṃ viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti ||
sn22.126:2.13: samudayavayadhammaṃ viññāṇaṃ Samudayavayadhammam viññāṇanti yathābhūtaṃ na pajānāti || || 9
sn22.126:3.1: Evaṃ vutte so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||

sn22.126:4.2: vayadhammaṃ rūpam Vayadhammaṃ rūpanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ||
